implementation: Eva-owned local read-only adapter; not an extracted official artifact viewer
implemented: XLSX cell values, cached formulas, common number formats, base styles, widths, heights and merges
PPTX ordered slide text, embedded bitmaps, background and common direct shapes
Sheet/slide navigation, zoom, responsive slide fit and theme-aware reader toolbar
Local content search across worksheets and slides; result counts represent cells/text boxes
Ctrl/Cmd+F, previous/next and Enter/Shift+Enter search navigation
PPTX thumbnail navigation reuses the same element renderer, with arrow/Home/End keyboard navigation
limitations: Read-only: no Office editing or official artifact model import
Complex Excel custom formats, charts, conditional formats and comments are not complete
PPTX masters, group transforms, charts, gradient fills, complex shapes and animations are not complete
CSV/TSV require UTF-8; incompatible input returns an explicit encoding error
Official PrimaryRuntime plugins contain local and connected artifact tooling; this adapter does not claim those tools are unavailable, only that they are not yet integrated
